items.insight: Property damage carries 38% of program spend this year at $7.9M, with medical close behind at $6.4M. The two together outweigh every other category combined.

items.insight: Payments run ahead of last year in seven of nine months, with the widest gap in June at $2.41M against $1.78M. The March dip mirrors last year, so it reads as seasonal rather than a slowdown.

items.question: Which regions cost the most
items.refinedQuestion: Top 8 regions by total paid, this fiscal year

steps.label: Reading report context
steps.detail: Program Spend: 14 measures, 9 dimensions, fiscal year window

steps.label: Matching measures and dimensions
steps.detail: cost maps to total_paid; regions has 48 members

steps.label: Refining the question
steps.detail: 48 regions would not read as a chart. Limiting to the top 8 by paid amount.

items.insight: Gulf Coast leads at $3.42M, almost a third more than the next region. The top 8 of 48 regions carry 61% of all program spend, so the long tail is real but thin.
